import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain both fixed development-state inference profiles without reading held-out scores'}, '3764fa359b9082ea5a1e4a5e3ac3aaf6e9671636'),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'sessions': [], 'comparisons': {},
          'interpretation': 'Descriptive timings from two cold allocations, two randomized repeats each; fixed development states and adapters. Not training-seed replication, policy PnL or a benchmark confidence interval. Compiler and allocator history remain part of execution.'}
profiles = {}
ledger_path = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())
for suffix in ('', '_repeat'):
    name = 'kaggle_inference_profile' + suffix
    pull = json.loads(Path('results/training/' + name + '.json').read_text())
    assert pull['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
    source = Path('runs/' + name + '_output')
    out = Path('results/kaggle/inference-profile' + ('-repeat' if suffix else '') + '-v1')
    shutil.copytree(source, out, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    pair = json.loads((out / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
    record['sessions'].append({'kernel': pull['metadata']['id'], 'version': 1, 'pair_runtime': pair,
                               'download_receipt': 'results/training/' + name + '.json',
                               'files_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}})
    for stage in ('sft', 'grpo'):
        p = out / stage / 'inference_profile.json'
        if p.exists():
            profiles[(suffix, stage)] = json.loads(p.read_text())
    for session in ledger['sessions']:
        if session['kernel'] == pull['metadata']['id'] and session['version'] == 1:
            session.update(status='completed_outputs_retrieved' if pair['exit_codes'] == [0, 0] else 'partial_outputs_retrieved',
                           script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'], hours=pair['wall_seconds'] / 3600,
                           hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; allocation startup/finalization billing boundaries unavailable.',
                           observed_complete_at=pull['polls'][-1]['at'], result_file=str(out / 'pair_runtime.json'))
for stage in ('sft', 'grpo'):
    available = [(suffix, p) for (suffix, s), p in profiles.items() if s == stage]
    if not available:
        continue
    assert len({p['prompts_sha256'] for _, p in available}) == 1
    assert len({p['profile_driver_sha256'] for _, p in available}) == 1
    summaries = {}
    for size in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16):
        cases = [m for _, p in available for m in p['measurements'] if m['batch_size'] == size]
        if cases:
            summaries[size] = {'measurements': len(cases), 'wall_seconds': [m['wall_seconds'] for m in cases],
                               'median_wall_seconds': median(m['wall_seconds'] for m in cases),
                               'peak_allocated_bytes': max(m['peak_allocated_bytes'] for m in cases),
                               'peak_reserved_bytes': max(m['peak_reserved_bytes'] for m in cases),
                               'quote_mismatches_vs_same_session_initial_serial': [m['quote_mismatch_indices'] for m in cases]}
    baseline = available[0][1]['initial_serial_baseline_including_warmup']['quotes']
    cold = {suffix or 'first': [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(baseline, p['initial_serial_baseline_including_warmup']['quotes'])) if a != b]
            for suffix, p in available}
    record['comparisons'][stage] = {'profile_statuses': {suffix or 'first': p['status'] for suffix, p in available},
                                     'unique_prompts': available[0][1]['unique_prompts'],
                                     'observations': len(available[0][1]['states']), 'batch_sizes': summaries,
                                     'cold_initial_serial_mismatch_indices': cold}
ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
Path('results/training/kaggle_inference_profile_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record['comparisons'], indent=2))
